string.text: Extreme Ragdoll
Main Controls
On Damage Mode
Overall Effect Strength
Master multiplier used to derive the amplified native killing-blow impulse. Default12. Enter any non-negative finite number.
Minimum Death Force
Guaranteed requested-force floor used before conversion to the native killing-blow impulse. Default 150000.
Upward Lift
Uncapped upward component added to the launch direction. Default 0.25.
Damage Influence
Uncapped scaling from killing-blow damage. Set 0 for uniform launches. Default 1.25.
Impact Spin
Adds a lateral bias to the single native death-impulse direction. Default 0.
Death Animation Time Before Ragdoll (seconds)
Original death-animation time before accelerated ragdoll handoff. The launch impulse is already part of the native death event. Default 0.005 seconds.
Movement Momentum Carryover
Blends the victim's movement at the instant of death into the native launch direction. Default 1.0.
Maximum Death Force (0 = Unlimited)
Optional user ceiling. Leave 0 for no mod-imposed force cap.
Mount Collision Kill Strength

Extra ExtremeRagdoll contribution for lethal horse-body collisions after Bannerlord's native charge/shove impulse. 0 = native Bannerlord mount shove only; 1 = full normal fallback contribution. Default 0.10 based on runtime testing: keeps mount kills enhanced while avoiding the cloth-separation threshold seen with larger stacked post-ragdoll translation.
Enable Push On Damage

Applies a visible native KnockBack reaction plus a short directional acceleration burst to surviving agents whenever they take damage. Disabled by default. Agents already in a natural ragdoll use the same mapped central-body ragdoll-force route.
Damage Push Strength
Uncapped master multiplier for nonlethal damage pushes. Default 1.0.
Base Damage Push
Base acceleration applied on every damaging nonlethal hit. Default 1.5. Enter any non-negative finite number.
Additional Push Per Damage
Damage scaling. This amount is added for every point of damage before the master multiplier. Default 0.04. Set 0 for fixed-strength pushes.
Damage Push Upward Lift
Adds an upward component to nonlethal pushes. Default 0.12.
Enable Knockdown Below Health Threshold
Replaces the normal KnockBack reaction with Bannerlord's native KnockDown reaction after a surviving hit leaves the agent at or below the configured health percentage. Enabled by default.
Knockdown Health Threshold (%)
Post-hit health percentage at or below which the native knockdown is requested. Default 50. Values above 100 make every surviving hit eligible; 0 effectively disables surviving-agent knockdowns.
Only Push When Knockdown Threshold Is Met

When enabled, the normal on-damage push is withheld unless the actual post-hit health is at or below the knockdown threshold. This creates a combined push-and-knockdown trigger instead of pushing on every hit.
Force Pulse Count
Legacy pulse count folded into the strength of the single native killing-blow impulse for normal deaths. No post-death translation pulses are applied on the native path. Default 2.
Pulse Interval (seconds)
Retained for backward-compatible settings. Normal death launches now use one native death impulse, so this no longer spaces post-death translation pulses.
Pulse Decay
Multiplier used when folding the configured legacy pulse sequence into the equivalent single native killing-blow impulse. Default 0.85.
Engine Killing-Blow Direction Influence

Retained for configuration compatibility. The normal death launch now originates directly from the killing Blow inside Bannerlord's native death pipeline, so no separate post-death KillingBlow-direction blend is required.
Linear Velocity Limit (0 = Disabled)
Optional engine velocity limit. Leave 0 for no mod-imposed limit.
Angular Velocity Limit (0 = Disabled)
Optional engine spin limit. Leave 0 for no mod-imposed limit.
Delivered Force Ceiling Per Pulse (0 = Unlimited)
Legacy per-pulse delivery ceiling used when folding the configured pulse sequence into one native killing-blow impulse. Default 60000. Set 0 for no equivalent-delivery ceiling.
Debug Logging
Writes hit, kill, ragdoll transition and pulse events to ExtremeRagdoll.Safe.log.
